text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days have passed since that 
broadcast. Inari One has been training as 
passionately as ever. However—
choice_data_list:
(...Is it really okay to leave things like 
this?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the 'top' of the regional 
circuits was Inari One's way of showing 
her love for Ohi in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And yet, if that ends up causing friction 
between Inari One and the Master, and by 
extension Ohi, it feels like her heartfelt 
feelings would all go to waste—
choice_data_list: (I really can't just leave her alone...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The next day. I gathered my resolve and 
came alone to Oi Racecourse, keeping it a 
secret from Inari One.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
—Huh!? If it isn't Big Sis Inari's 
Trainer! Are you all by yourself today?
choice_data_list: I just wanted to see you, Boss...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
To the boss? Just a moment, please. 
—Boss~~! You have a visitor~!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
Hold on! No need to shout so loud... Wait, 
aren't you—
choice_data_list:
There's something I'd like to discuss with 
you regarding Inari.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I revealed to the Boss Inari One's 
true motive for running on local circuits, 
as well as what she was aiming for—

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
Regional running is in no way inferior to 
the Central... You'll claim the "top" in 
both Regional and Central and proudly 
declare it to the world... is that it?

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text: Geez, that Inari...

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
Well ain't that sweet of you to say. That 
makes a whole lot of sense to me, then.

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
—Even so. That's exactly why I can't ever 
forgive them... And I don't like it one 
bit!!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Hate to bother ya, but I'm 
dropping by Tracsen Academy right now. 
Mind clearing things with security for me?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...――

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...I gotta run even more. Otherwise, 
there's no way I'll ever beat everyone at 
Ohi...!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
—Well, well, well, well! Look who's 
putting everything into self-training, 
Inari!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Huh— Wait, what?! Boss?! What are you 
doing here?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ngh, no way...—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Why, of all people...!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text: —Get outta here, you fool!!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
...Your Trainer was worried about ya, and 
it broke their heart to tell me.

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
Complaining about that... wouldn't be very 
classy, would it?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
Listen here, Inari. I understand full well 
what you're tryin' to do. Full well, but—

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
I can't stand this! Yeah, I hate it so 
damn much! You're one massive idiot, you 
hear me?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. I've got no words to defend 
myself. I really did twist the boss's 
words and try to run in the regional 
circuit instead of the central—

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
Get outta here!! That ain't what's tickin' 
me off!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
“—Why haven't you come to boldly declare 
that you're aiming for the top?”

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
T-That's...! It's precisely because I know 
how capable the Boss and everyone in Ohi 
are that I can't take this lightly—

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
I'm tellin' you that's what pisses me 
off!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Gah!?

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
Don't go making up fancy excuses just 
'cause you're chicken! If you wanna fight 
for the "top spot," puff out your chest 
and pick a fight with us fair and square!!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
"Or did you really think you could say you 
reached the 'top' all on your own without 
ever getting into a decent brawl? You 
complete moron!!"

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
What kind of value does reaching "the top" 
like that even have?!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
Besides that, you went and decided on your 
own that "this is how it should be" and 
stubbornly—

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
Ignoring the partner you're running the 
Twinkle Series with doesn't sit right with 
me either.

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
Did ya go and forget all about it while 
spending time at Tracen Academy, Inari?

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
A festival ain't somethin' you can pull 
off all by yourself, ya know.

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text: So what that means is—

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
――Inari One of the JRA!! Clean out those 
ears and listen up good!!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
Your ambition to seize the "top" from the 
regionals! As a representative of Oi, I've 
received it loud and clear!! However—

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text: —The ones who will win... are us!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: "...Thank you so much, boss. Boss—"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—I, the humble Inari One!! Here and now, 
without hiding or running, make this vow! 
With all my heart and soul, I shall bloom 
brilliantly upon the soil of Ohi—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'll be taking the "top" spot in the 
regionals!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Please... prepare yourself for when that 
time comes!!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text: —Heh, bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
The "top." Just try and take it from me if 
you can. Like hell I'll let you.

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer. Well then, I'll be taking my 
leave. Thanks for letting me through."

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
—See ya, Inari. Make sure you're in top 
shape. 'Cause we're strong as hell.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, I know all too well. That is 
precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Now that makes taking the "top" all the 
more worth it...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Boss, thanks for today.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Thanks for today, Sis.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"And on top of that... I'm real sorry. I 
ended up makin' ya worry for nothing."
choice_data_list:
I'm truly sorry for speaking without 
thinking, too...

I'm sorry... for going on like that on my 
own. I'm really sorry.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Forget about that already! ...Let's both 
just reset and move on. I learned my 
lesson real well today too."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That I made assumptions about what the 
Master thought... and rushed ahead on my 
own without even knowing how you felt.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I was just running away from everyone, 
being completely selfish on my own... But 
I'm never doing that again!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna say it loud and proud! Face it 
head-on! I'll take on everyone in Ohi fair 
and square and claim the "top"!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"And to make that happen... I'm countin' 
on you again starting tomorrow, Boss!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"And to make that happen... I'm countin' 
on you again starting tomorrow, Boss 
Lady!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Relieved that the misunderstanding between 
Inari One and the Boss had been resolved, 
I was reminded once again of how strong 
her bond with Ohi truly was—
